title: test_falsifier_verdict's live-ticket tooth finds the commons beside the repo root
intention: The live-ticket tooth in test_falsifier_verdict derives the repo root as parents[6], so it finds CairnCommons beside the repo on every box without the home-checkout fallback.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: on Windows parents[5] of test_falsifier_verdict.py resolves to C:\automation\local\cairn\cairn, with no CairnCommons beside it, so the tooth reds with 'names no ticket on file'; parents[6] resolves to C:\automation\local\cairn, which has CairnCommons beside it, and ~/dev/src/cairn does not exist on Windows
traces_to: Law 3: a green reached only through a fallback is not known green until measured without it; Law 8: the tooth must fail when the line is wrong.
how: In cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_falsifier_verdict.py change parents[5] to parents[6] at the tooth's `here` line. Red-first proof: a child process with HOME and USERPROFILE set to an empty scratch dir (so ~/dev/src/cairn cannot exist) runs that tooth and must exit 0; the old line reds it on Linux as well as Windows.

clauses.claim: the live-ticket tooth of test_falsifier_verdict, run in a child process whose HOME and USERPROFILE name an empty scratch dir, exits 0, where it exited 1 with 'names no ticket on file' on the unfixed line

decisions.text: D2: one proof, one tooth per clause; red first.

measured.saw: on Windows parents[5] of test_falsifier_verdict.py resolves to C:\automation\local\cairn\cairn, with no CairnCommons beside it, so the tooth reds with 'names no ticket on file'; parents[6] resolves to C:\automation\local\cairn, which has CairnCommons beside it, and ~/dev/src/cairn does not exist on Windows
measured.how: a python one-liner printing parents[5] and parents[6] and whether CairnCommons/tickets sits beside each; test_falsifier_verdict.py run bare before and after

measured.saw: on Linux the same line goes green only through the ~/dev/src/cairn fallback (orchestrator's reading: the home checkout exists there); the new proof's child, with HOME pointed at an empty dir, reds on the old line and passes on the new, twice
measured.how: the new proof run bare on akiendell before and after the one-character change; Linux reading relayed by the orchestrator, to be re-taken on Linux
